cards.title: Consent Is a Digest
items: Agreement is recorded against a stable digest of the manifest, not a one-time yes
A release that reads one more file produces a different digest and asks again
Revoking is deleting ~/.tokenhud/consent.json - no account, no server involved

cards.title: Shown Before Anything
items: --what-i-read prints every path resolved against your machine - real counts and sizes, reading nothing
--dry-run shows the exact payload it would send, sent nowhere
With no terminal to ask on, the agent stops and tells you how to agree explicitly

cards.title: Held to the Code by Tests
items: One test greps every collector for path literals and fails on anything the manifest does not declare
One fails if the manifest claims a path nothing reads
One asserts the excluded ~/.claude.json keys appear nowhere in the code that opens it
